assets.method: Generated opaque stylized front-facing rock fill, with one style correction. Geometry and alpha are not part of the texture.
assets.review: Rendered on eight canonically authored north-platform cliff edges in the first level. The west side remains a traversable two-column grass ramp; foot, flying and starting-unit connectivity are checked against the same rule data. Real camera review accepts the grass/soil lip as a readable foundation, not final natural highland art. The south hill remains a continuous grass slope.

assets.method: Generated single-building replacement, visually reviewed in the actual first-level scene; not a crop or lossless edit.
assets.visualContract: Single stone-and-timber gatehouse with one normal frame. No baked ownership or compound courtyard; the canonical owner banner supplies allegiance. Door threshold and front foundation contact are separately authored.
assets.review: Visible body height approximately 120 world units; doorway approximately 39 against ordinary infantry about 30. Real first-level window verified door selection at (5,13), neighboring hero selection and ground contact. Removed ten first-level miniature compound/tent/prop placements; other levels retain their authored scenery. Shared topic resource projections checked across all 16 levels.

assets.method: Generated opaque hand-painted fine grass fill, with one density and contrast correction. No pixel post-processing, roads, terrain silhouette or baked slope lighting.
assets.review: Accepted as an iteration after matching opening and north-platform close camera review. Fine warm olive grass replaces oversized camouflage patches; no obvious repeat seam at those actual scales. Surface shading remains derived from canonical projected geometry normals. The warm palette and overall landscape naturalness remain subject to further visual refinement.
